Screenshots referenced by the package README. Not published to consuming apps — this
directory isn't part of any `vendor:publish` tag or the Composer package export.

Expected files (referenced by `../../README.md`):

- `new-conversation.png` — the `chat.new` component: starting a new conversation.
- `thread.png` — a `chat.conversation` thread with at least one assistant reply.
- `trace-inspector.png` — the same thread with "show thoughts" expanded, showing a
  tool call and its HTTP request correctly nested underneath it.
- `filament-embed.png` — the chat component embedded inside a Filament panel page.
